title: Chapter 222: God Bless The Xiao Clan
content:
Chapter 222: God Bless The Xiao Clan

Because as long as Xiao Luo does not die, he will become the pillar of the Xiao clan and the top powerhouse in the fairyland in the future.

But now, everything is different.

The Xiao clan is about to exterminate the clan, and there is also the participation of his Xie clan. Xiao Luo will not die, and the Xie clan will be miserable in the future.

So now, Xiao Luo must die.

Looking at the three powerful Xie clans who were rushing towards him and full of murderous intentions, Xiao Luo's face looked extremely ugly.

And the senior executives of the Xiao clan also saw this scene.

Faced with so many enemies, they were too busy to take care of themselves, so how could they leave to help Xiao Luo get out of trouble?

"Xie Changshou, do you really want to do so amazingly?!"

Xiao Jing said in a fierce voice.

Obviously, many years ago, the Xie clan and the Xiao clan were two very close families, and the geniuses of the two families often interacted with each other.

But now, it has become a mortal enemy.

Hearing this, the patriarch of the Xie clan was expressionless.

"I can't go back to everything."

Seeing that the three Xie clan strong men had already killed in front of Xiao Luo, Xiao Jing roared unwillingly.

"No!!"

At this moment, one of the three powerful Xie clans suddenly turned against him and slashed the long sword in his hand towards the two beside him.

Puchi!

Two rays of blood sputtered, and the two powerful Xie clans looked frightened and angry, "What are you doing?!"

Not only him, they couldn't believe it.

The same is true for the rest of the people who saw this scene, including Xiao Luo.

"Xie San! What are you doing!"

The patriarch of Xie clan roared.

He didn't expect that his own people would turn against him.

Xie San, the Xie tribe member who turned against him, looked ugly, "Class leader, sorry, the lady is my benefactor, I must repay her."

After saying that, Xie San looked at Xiao Luo behind him.

"Young Master Xiao Luo, my lady asked me to tell you that she is sorry for you, you must live well."

Although Xie San did not name his name, how could Xiao Luo not know whose masterpiece this was?

Suddenly, my heart was extremely complicated.

However, Xiao Luo was only confused for a moment and quickly turned around and continued to run away.

No words were said.

Watching Xiao Luo run away, everyone in the Xiao clan felt relieved.

But the patriarch of the Xie clan directly broke the defense.

"Ah! A bunch of waste, a bunch of waste!!"

"Kill Xie San for me, kill him!!"

The patriarch Xie clan stood in the void, roaring while fighting.

At this moment, the entire Xiao clan had already been defeated and retreated step by step.

Originally, the strong men of the three clans could win quickly with a crushing advantage, but they were still too proud.

After all, in their opinion, the Xiao clan was already at the end of his strength. Without the Xiao clan, it was just a matter of raising his head.

But it is because of their pride that they lose this only opportunity.

At this time, Xiao Luo was crying while constantly speeding up and frantically traveling through the Xiao clan's ancestral land. Although it was hazy in front of him, Xiao Luo didn't dare to stop at all.

But at this moment, he suddenly stopped and looked in front of him with horror.

"Um?"

......

"Hahaha, your Xiao clan is completely finished today!"

The head of the Chu clan stood in the void and shouted to the sky.

It can be said to be full of energy.

At this moment, the powerful people of the Xiao clan suffered heavy casualties, and almost no one was intact.

A strong despair continued to spread from the Xiao clan.

"Old ancestor, please show your power and save Xiao clan!"

Xiao Chen had no choice but to kneel on the ground and roar unwillingly.

Seeing this, the rest of the Xiao clan also started learning.

There is really no way.

The three tribes watched this scene and sneered disdainfully.

"Now, even if your Xiao ancestor comes, you can't save you."

"Yeah?"

As soon as he finished speaking, an extremely cold and domineering voice suddenly sounded from the Xiao clan’s ancestral land.

The sound instantly resounded throughout the Xiao clan.

Everyone was stunned.

The next moment, an unimaginable aura surged out of the Xiao clan's ancestral land.

This is the aura that only when countless top-level strong men gather together can burst out.

Suddenly, everyone present looked at the Xiao clan’s ancestral land.

boom!

There was a loud bang.

Dozens of figures soared into the sky from the Xiao clan's ancestral land, and then stood in the void, glaring proudly at the powerful people of the three tribes present.

"Is it worthy to destroy my Xiao clan?!"

Xiao Yong was the first to stand up and stomped on the void.

As the terrifying explosion sounded, the void shattered, and Xiao Yong's aura was exposed to everyone's eyes without reservation.

He is a peak powerhouse in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

"What!"

At this moment, when the three tribes saw this, they suddenly said in a lost voice.

There are such powerful people in the Xiao clan.

"Don't, don't panic. Isn't it just the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm? My clan has it too."

By now, the words of retreating to the ground are no longer practical, so the Ye clan leader had to speak and comfort him.

When everyone heard this, they breathed a sigh of relief.

Just the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

In the family present, there is no one like that.

Hearing this, the powerful Xiao clan snorted coldly in the void.

The next moment, thirty-six powerful Xiao clans exploded collectively.

Boom!

The void was shattered and the wind and clouds changed drastically. At this moment, the entire Xiao clan began to tremble wildly.

A huge dome was directly lifted up from the sky.

At this moment, everyone present was completely confused.

Among the thirty-six powerful people in the Xiao clan, the lowest of them are the ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

There are twelve people at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

What the hell is this concept!

At this moment, the strong men of the three tribes were already trembling.

The heads of the three tribes were even pale and looked at the scene in disbelief.

"This, how is this possible?"

"Fake, fake, all fake...."

"I must be dreaming, yes, dreaming, 

The three patriarchs went from shock to gradually becoming crazy.

Obviously, I have almost lost my mind, and I don’t know if it’s true or pretending.

It was not until now that Xiao Jing and others barely reacted.

That is, the strong man of their Xiao clan who has entered the ancestral land for tens of millions of years.

They are really still alive.

Thinking about it, both the Lord of Huang City and Miss Lu have come out, which means that the problem in the ancestral land should have been solved.

But they didn't expect that the strong men of their Xiao clan were still there.

"Class leader, that's the patriarch!"

Several Xiao people recognized Xiao Mo in the void at first glance.

They all became excited.

"Oh my God, then, that's not Xiao Yin! She, too!"

Xiao Yin, the peerless monster of the Xiao clan million years ago.

He has topped the list of demons in the Immortal Realm and dominated the list for tens of thousands of years. He shocked the Immortal Realm and was hailed as a genius who will change the fate of the Xiao clan.

Unfortunately, God's will makes people so Xiao Yin finally chose to enter the ancestral land, trying to save the Xiao clan with his own strength.

Later, there was no news again.

It can be said to be a flash in the pan.

I thought this Xiao tribe monster had already died in the Xiao tribe's ancestral land, but now, Xiao Yin is not only still alive, but has also reached the peak of the terrifying Immortal Emperor realm.

"God bless Xiao clan!"

Xiao Jing suddenly laughed to the sky.

All the worries in my heart were completely wiped out at this moment.
